acceptance.given: Package A execution is in scope and its network behavior is being checked.

oracle.expected: The Package A validation record shows no URL-request operation is performed or authorized by Package A.
forbidden: A URL-request operation is emitted, invoked, or authorized by Package A.
oracle.observable: The structured Package A validation result and its captured operation/declaration record for the network capability check.

acceptance.then: Package A completes without requesting a URL.
acceptance.when: Run the Package A capability validation and inspect its structured result and operation/declaration record for URL-request activity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Package A network-capability test selector and fail when the validator or captured check records any URL-request operation, or when the required no-request record cannot be produced.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement Package A network-capability validation and its focused test so URL-request activity is rejected and the no-request outcome is observable in the structured validation record.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; reverting the validator implementation removes this Package A capability check only.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package A network-capability validation moves from an in-scope declaration to a completed structured check whose record contains no URL-request operation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted capability test passes only when the validator produces a structured Package A result with zero URL-request operations and rejects any URL-request operation; inability to produce or inspect that record fails the test.
